items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Now who was the Bronze Bannikens? ... INTERVIEWEE: No, that was Charles Taylor.

ctx.x: Well, to get back to the, you're getting there, you were playing with Miramaks, Miramakas? Miramakas. Now who was the Bronze Bannikens? That was the same album?
